canonical_project: Pantheon AI Topusko hyperscale AI data center campus
notes: Pantheon Atlas announced a Topusko campus with 1 GW total capacity and 800 MW usable IT load on a 310-acre site, expandable to 450 acres, with construction planned for early 2027 and full operations targeted for Q1 2029. A 2026-07-23 company release says Croatia's transmission operator HOPS approved the power-supply blueprint; Sisak-Moslavina County formally recognized the project as regionally important.
